title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on Android: choose style and format, and apply a brand kit, for visual creations
summary: Hold: the briefing says every user can apply a published official brand kit, but the Android roadmap requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. The roadmap facts and documented control paths and commands otherwise check out; the creation-policy path and audit checklist need small corrections.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Every user can apply a published official brand kit and its assets reach the whole organisation without an eligibility qualification.
claims.quote: Why it matters: 'every user can apply it'; Scope: 'Applying a brand kit is limited to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, per the roadmap item.'
claims.fix: Replace 'every user can apply it' with 'users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence can apply it'. Replace 'A published official brand kit is available to every user' with 'The brand kit policies allow users outside both policy groups to use published official kits, subject to the feature's licence requirement'. Replace 'Anything a brand manager adds to an official kit reaches the whole organisation' with 'Published official kits can make approved assets available to eligible users across the organisation'.

claims.fix: Set controls[1].ui.path to 'Customization > Policy Management > policy > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Restrict brand kit creation'. The omitted page only requires Next; this is not a wrong route.
